title: ConvAnalysisTopic - Data API
description: Represents a topic generated from the Sales Signals refresh or run. For example, a product experiencing issues due to high pricing could be a topic identified through the analysis of multiple calls. This object is available in API version 63.0 and later.

CallPercentage.description: The percentage of calls that apply to a topic, out of the total number of calls that were analyzed.

Category.description: A classification or grouping used to filter topics. This field is used in conjunction with Keyword.

ConvAnalysisSummaryId.description: The conversation analysis summary associated with the topic. This field is a relationship field.

GenerationsIdentifier.description: The ID used to track the LLM-generated response for feedback purposes.

Keyword.description: A specific word used in conjunction with Category to filter topics. For example, Product:Salesforce, where the keyword is Salesforce.

MentionCount.description: The number of call insights associated with the topic.

Order.description: A numerical value used to sort topics in a sequence.

Summary.description: A detailed explanation of the topic.

Title.description: The title of the topic that describes it.

TopicSentiment.description: The sentiment of the topic, whether it’s negative, neutral, or positive.

TotalCalls.description: The total number of calls analyzed for the topic.

TotalCallsForCategoryKeyword.description: The total number of calls analyzed for category:keyword. Multiple topics can be under a single category:keyword.

TotalMentionsForCategoryKeyword.description: The total number of mentions analyzed for category:keyword.

TurnIdentifier.description: UUID that is generated and used to track a group of LLM-generated content.

special_access_rules: Users need the Sales Signals permission set and the Sales Signals feature must be enabled.
